cases.question: It is my main phase, the chain is empty, and I hold priority. May I play a spell?

sentences.text: You may play a spell right now.

cases.question: When both players pass on a closed chain, does the whole chain resolve?

sentences.text: Only the newest item resolves, and then priority opens again.

cases.question: If my spell kills their unit, do I draw a card from the follow-up effect?

sentences.text: You draw the card.

cases.question: It is my main phase and I hold priority. May I play a spell, and may my opponent?

Your opponent cannot play one before you pass.
